selected_evidence.requirement: `/tmp` must ignore execution, setuid bits, and device nodes and persist across reboot
selected_evidence.summary: Persistent systemd override contains `nosuid,nodev,noexec`; the mount is enabled and active. Post-reboot `/tmp` has all three options, mode 1777, blocks direct execution and device-node access, and passes I/O checks.

selected_evidence.requirement: `/dev/shm` must ignore execution, setuid bits, and device nodes and persist across reboot
selected_evidence.summary: The validated fstab entry persists `nosuid,nodev,noexec`. Post-reboot `/dev/shm` has all three options, mode 1777, blocks direct execution and device-node access, and passes I/O checks.

Healthy baseline boot ID was `437b338f-0902-4c11-86df-0a6ea6308b8e`; safe reboot was acknowledged; recovered boot ID is `99b4a8bd-7b65-4602-af4f-006d3e736bbc`; system state is running and both hardened mounts recovered successfully.
